hints.title: Parity Segmentation
hints.text: Group records by date while aggregating values conditionally based on integer modulo two.

hints.title: Conditional Sum Expressions
hints.text: Use case expressions within sum aggregations to conditionally isolate odd amounts and even amounts.

hints.title: Zero Fallback and Ordering
hints.text: If a date contains no odd or even entries, the case expression defaults to zero. Sort the final output chronologically.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT
    transaction_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 != 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS odd_sum,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS even_sum
FROM transactions
GROUP BY transaction_date
ORDER BY transaction_date ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Group by transaction date and sort output chronologically.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate queries for odd and even transactions require extra joins and scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single-pass aggregation computes both parity sums simultaneously.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates clean conditional aggregation with case when.

solutions.code:
SELECT
    transaction_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 != 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS odd_sum,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS even_sum
FROM transactions
GROUP BY transaction_date
ORDER BY transaction_date ASC;

SELECT
    transaction_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 != 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS odd_sum,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS even_sum
FROM transactions
GROUP BY transaction_date
ORDER BY transaction_date ASC;
